question: Who founded the famous Vikramashila University in the 9th century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dharmapala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikramashila **was **one of the three **most **important Buddhist monasteries **in **India during **the **Pala Empire**, along with **Nalanda and Odantapuri**.
 
• It was **established **in **response to a supposed decline **in **the quality of scholarship **at **Nalanda**.
 
• **Vikramashila University **is **located in Bihar**.
 
• It is **founded by Dharmapala**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ballal Sen **in **vernacular literature **was the **second ruler **of the **Sena dynasty **of the **Bengal region **of the **Indian subcontinent**. He was the **son and successor **of **Vijaya Sena** and ended the **Pala Empire **by **defeating Govindapala**.
 
• **Gopala **was the **founder of the Pala dynasty **of **Bihar and Bengal regions **of the **Indian Subcontinent. **The last **morpheme **of his name **Pala means "protector" **and was used as an **ending **for the **names of all the Pala monarchs**.
 
• The **dynasty's founder **of **Sena dynasty **was **Samanta Sena**. After him came **Hemanta Sena **who usurped power and styled himself**, king, in 1095 AD**.
